name: Cream of Asparagus Soup
description: A creamy and smooth asparagus soup made with canned asparagus, perfect for serving year-round with optional fresh garnishes.
recipeIngredient: 2 (12 oz) cans asparagus tips or cuttings

recipeInstructions.text: Chop onions and celery medium fine and sauté in butter until limp but not brown.
Add flour and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually add chicken stock (dissolve bouillon cubes in water) and stir until smooth.
Bring to a boil, then add canned asparagus including liquid and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.
Purée the soup in a blender and press through a sieve for a smooth texture.
To serve, bring soup to a boil, remove from heat, and stir in whipping cream.
Season to taste and keep warm over low heat without boiling.

keywords: asparagus soup, creamy soup, canned asparagus

_similar.name: Cream of Cucumber Soup
_similar.description: A refreshing and creamy cucumber soup made with chicken broth, milk, and a hint of cayenne pepper.

recipeInstructions.text: In the microwave, cook onions and olive oil on High for 2 minutes.
Dice cucumbers and add to onions. Cook until soft.
Use a blender to purée the cucumbers (hand blender works well).
Mix the flour with ¼ cup chicken broth. Add to the cucumbers, along with the remaining chicken broth, cayenne, and nutmeg. Cook 6 to 8 minutes on High.
Add the milk and dill. Serve.

_similar.keywords: cucumber soup, creamy soup, refreshing soup

_similar.name: French Onion Soup
_similar.description: A classic French onion soup made with caramelized onions, consomme, and topped with melted mozzarella cheese and croutons.
recipeIngredient: 4 Oxo cubes dissolved in 2 cups hot water

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter. Saute onions until transparent.
Add to Oxo, consomme and water. Simmer about 2 hours.
Put in onion soup bowls, add a slice of French bread on top of each one and add shredded mozzarella cheese sprinkled over each.
Put in oven at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: French onion soup, caramelized onions, melted cheese

_similar.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and comforting broccoli soup made with potatoes, chicken broth, and a touch of Miracle Whip for richness.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add potatoes and broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes or until tender.
Purée the mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the puréed mixture back into the saucepan. Using a whisk, blend in Miracle Whip and seasonings.
Heat the soup thoroughly, stirring occasionally, until warmed through. Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: creamy broccoli soup, potato soup, comforting soup
